summary: The diff implements all three requirements: a backend user registration status system (REQ-1), frontend routing based on approval status with pending/rejected screens (REQ-2), and an Admin Panel page for SuperAdmin to manage users (REQ-3). However, several specific acceptance criteria have gaps or ambiguities worth noting.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes a query to retrieve the caller's own status (the actual status value: SuperAdmin, Active, Pending, Rejected, Suspended), not just a boolean.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend exposes isCallerApproved() returning a Bool, but there is no direct query that returns the caller's own status enum value. REQ-1 AC specifies a query to retrieve the caller's own status, implying the status value itself should be returned.

missing_requirements.requirement: The status field must include all five values: SuperAdmin, Active, Pending, Rejected, Suspended stored per principal in stable state.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend defines UserStatus with all five variants but the actual approval system uses a separate UserApproval module with only three states (pending/approved/rejected). Suspended and the SuperAdmin/Active distinction do not appear to be tracked in the approval state used by the frontend.

missing_requirements.requirement: Rejected users see a full-screen rejection screen and cannot access any other page.
missing_requirements.reason: PendingApprovalPage attempts to detect rejection by calling useListApprovals which is an admin-only query that will trap for non-admin users. Non-admin rejected users cannot access listApprovals, so the rejection detection path is broken for the primary use case.

hallucinated_features.description: A requestApproval button and mutation was added to PendingApprovalPage, allowing pending users to re-request approval.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention any re-request approval functionality. The pending screen should only display a waiting message; no user action to re-request was specified.

hallucinated_features.description: A search/filter input was added to the Admin Panel user table.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request specifies only a basic table of users with approve/reject actions. No search or filter functionality was requested, and advanced filters were explicitly listed as a non-goal.

hallucinated_features.description: A confirmation AlertDialog was added to the Admin Panel before approving or rejecting a user.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention a confirmation step. The AC states clicking Approve updates status to Active and clicking Reject updates to Rejected with no confirmation dialog specified.
